reason: Displays remaining quotas, balances, usage windows, reset times, and plan details for configured model providers in the DSH web interface, with polling, refresh status, and inline settings badges.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中展示已配置模型供应商的余额、配额窗口、重置时间和套餐信息。
summaries.en: Displays balances, quota windows, reset times, and plan information for configured model providers in the DSH web interface.

capabilities: Reads configured provider credentials through the host credential service or environment variables
Makes authenticated requests to provider usage and billing endpoints
Exposes aggregated provider quota data through a local host route
Injects quota badges and detail panels into the web interface
